explanation: The theorem says that over a local ring, the stable elementary subgroup E(R) equals the kernel of the determinant on the stable general linear group. Both objects (`stableElementarySubgroup` and the stable GL with its `det`) are defined in this library. I searched Mathlib for `stableElementary`, `StableGL` and `elementarySubgroup` and found nothing. Mathlib has no stable general linear group and no stable elementary subgroup. Its closest material is transvections in `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Transvection.lean`, which only covers fixed-size matrices over fields. So no single Mathlib declaration carries this result.
